description: Defines the QuicDefaultClient class, a client implementation for QUIC protocol, including constructors, destructor, and methods for creating sessions and accessing network helper.

classes.name: QuicDefaultClient
classes.description: A client class for QUIC protocol, supporting multiple constructors for different configurations, and methods to create sessions and access network helper.

methods.name: QuicDefaultClient
methods.description: Constructors for QuicDefaultClient with various parameters including server address, server ID, supported versions, configuration, event loop, network helper, proof verifier, and session cache.

methods.name: CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC client session with specified supported versions and connection.

methods.name: GetLatestFD
methods.description: Returns the latest file descriptor from the default network helper.

methods.name: default_network_helper
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the network helper used by the client.

methods.name: default_network_helper (const)
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the network helper used by the client.
